**Grouping the feedback**

Five reviews. Positives cluster around battery life, noise cancelling and comfort; negatives around app stability, heat and the case.

### Aurora X2 — review themes

| Theme | Mentions | Sentiment |
|---|---|---|
| Noise cancelling | 2 | positive |
| Battery life | 2 | positive |
| Sound & comfort | 2 | positive |
| Companion app stability | 2 | negative |
| Ear-cup heat | 1 | negative |
| Case build quality | 1 | negative |

**Takeaway:** the hardware is loved; the companion app is the main source of frustration.
